abstract_operation: Separate registered components from one measured device
conservation_rule: Components and residue partition the exact parent composition; authored component count is not a free bundle.

abstract_operation: Sort one saved mixed lot into disjoint feedstock lots
conservation_rule: Output component budgets sum exactly to input; each particle belongs to only one output lot.

abstract_operation: Run a sealed recovery cycle on compatible electronic feedstock
conservation_rule: Recover only actual finite metal masses; all unrecovered mass is residue or explicit loss; omit zero-mass outputs.

abstract_operation: Run a sealed recovery cycle on sorted feedstock
conservation_rule: Efficiencies apply once to actual component budgets; sorted lot identity does not create its named metal.

abstract_operation: Concentrate and refine a bounded ore batch
conservation_rule: All output metals come from saved ore composition; ore color and event prices do not generate mass.

abstract_operation: Concentrate and refine a bounded ore batch
conservation_rule: Track each present component separately and retain the exact inert balance.

abstract_operation: Concentrate and refine a bounded ore batch
conservation_rule: Trace precious metals are recovered only when authored into the input profile.

abstract_operation: Separate compatible gold-alloy feedstock into measured lots
conservation_rule: Gold and copper output plus residue/loss equal input; zero-efficiency components remain in residue.

abstract_operation: Separate compatible silver-alloy feedstock into measured lots
conservation_rule: Existing pure metal cannot gain mass on repeated remelting; all unmatched components stay in residue.

abstract_operation: Combine a measured 75 percent Au and 25 percent Cu charge
conservation_rule: Require both Au and Cu components and exact 7500 bps Au; requested total mass 1..100 g with actual sufficient input; all excess returns in measured lots.

abstract_operation: Combine a measured 92.5 percent Ag and 7.5 percent Cu charge
conservation_rule: Require both Ag and Cu components and exact 9250 bps Ag; requested total mass 1..100 g with actual sufficient input; all excess returns in measured lots.

abstract_operation: Fictionally convert the registered Cu component to Au
fee_rule: JobFee plus powder order if not already owned
conservation_rule: Consume source input and one core charge; preserve total mass and source purity; reserve entire Au output against daily permit. Output total mass must also be 1..100 g; insufficient quota or mass-range mismatch rejects before consumption.

abstract_operation: Fictionally convert the registered Ag component to Au
fee_rule: JobFee plus powder order if not already owned
conservation_rule: Consume source input and one core charge; preserve total mass and source purity; reject pre-existing Au to prevent recursive conversion. Output total mass must also be 1..100 g; insufficient quota or mass-range mismatch rejects before consumption.

abstract_operation: Cast a requested measured mass from compatible assayed granule lots
conservation_rule: Requested total mass 1..100 g; require sufficient actual mass; preserve weighted composition without purity upgrade; return all excess in measured lots and omit zero-mass outputs.
